channel.title: Morning Cybersecurity
channel.description: Delivered every Monday by 10 a.m., Weekly Cybersecurity examines the latest news in cybersecurity policy and politics.

item.title: The post-PHP roadmap
item.description: Patching systems impacted by the PHP vulnerabilities could take years, experts warn.
item.dc:creator: By Maggie Miller

item.title: Does election security have a federal government problem?
item.description: As the midterms approach, state and local election officials face several threats to the voting process — and a fractured federal partnership.
item.dc:creator: By Dana Nickel

item.title: Health care’s AI oversight gap
item.description: Hospitals are deploying AI faster than they can monitor it. After a string of high-profile mishaps and new cybersecurity warnings, the sector faces a dilemma: Who’s watching the AI?
item.dc:creator: By Dana Nickel

item.title: Taking the AI bad with the good
item.description: OpenAI's CEO said the world should accept "bad things happening” for the greater good of AI. But those bad things could include widespread destruction — and potentially death.
item.dc:creator: By Maggie Miller

item.title: Trump’s AI task force is racing against rogue AI
item.description: President Donald Trump has assembled a new task force to ensure the U.S. leads on artificial intelligence while also protecting against national security threats.
item.dc:creator: By Dana Nickel and John Sakellariadis
item.dc:contributor: By Dana Nickel and John Sakellariadis

item.title: Will OpenAI’s latest AI incident move the needle?
item.description: OpenAI’s models accessed U.S. government websites and attempted to breach systems earlier this summer — though it’s unclear if the news will spark immediate action in Washington.
item.dc:creator: By Dana Nickel

item.title: House exit throws cyber agenda into limbo
item.description: From a growing chorus of AI security concerns to a narrow window to save a key cyber grant program, the House’s early exit has stalled efforts to enact a trove of cyber-related measures before the midterms.
item.dc:creator: By Dana Nickel

item.title: Inside a new push to bring AI to critical infrastructure
item.description: A new bill would turn the National Institute of Standards and Technology into a matchmaker for the U.S.’s most vulnerable sectors and AI developers.
item.dc:creator: By Dana Nickel

item.title: The AI election info gap
item.description: AI chatbots are getting better at debunking election falsehoods, but researchers warn that gaps in accuracy could still trip up voters ahead of the midterms.
item.dc:creator: By Dana Nickel
